description: Foundation: fonts, oklch design tokens, global chrome (scroll-progress bar + sticky header shell), reworked Nav and Footer, and a shared client motion module. This establishes the design system + interaction primitives every redesigned page depends on, so it MUST land first. Adapts the prototype's single-file x-dc into the Next App Router shell (layout.tsx + globals.css + components). Verify with `unset NODE_OPTIONS && node scripts/check-copy.mjs src`.
steps: layout.tsx: add DM Sans and Space Grotesk via next/font/google alongside the existing fonts. DM Sans weights 400;500;600;700 variable --font-dm-sans; Space Grotesk weights 500;600;700 variable --font-space-grotesk. Add both variable classNames to the <html> className list. Keep the existing Organization JSON-LD, skip-link, <Nav/>, {children}, <Footer/>, <MotionControl/> mounts. Render a `<div id="scroll-progress" aria-hidden />` as the first child of <body> (fixed, top:0,left:0,height:3px,width:0%, pink->lavender gradient, z-index 200) so every page gets the scroll-progress bar.

globals.css @theme block: add oklch design tokens from the prototype as CSS custom properties usable across the redesign: --color-page: oklch(0.992 0.003 55); --color-ink: oklch(0.16 0.004 285); --color-muted: oklch(0.47 0.012 285); --color-accent: oklch(0.532 0.216 7); --color-accent-hover: oklch(0.64 0.26 7); --color-accent-light: oklch(0.82 0.17 7); --color-line: oklch(0.86 0.014 285); pastel fills oklch(0.92 0.05 305)/(0.94 0.04 220)/(0.94 0.052 145)/(0.96 0.06 88). Add font tokens --font-space-grotesk and --font-dm-sans mapping to the next/font vars. Do NOT delete existing tokens still referenced by unconverted CSS; you may leave them. Set body/html base: background var(--color-page), color var(--color-ink), font-family var(--font-dm-sans). Space Grotesk is for h1/h2/h3/display, metric values and the founder quote; DM Sans for body/UI/nav/buttons.

globals.css: add the three prototype keyframes verbatim in behavior: @keyframes pulse-dot (50%{opacity:.35;transform:scale(.75)}), @keyframes marquee-scroll (from translateX(0) to translateX(-50%)), @keyframes chip-drift (0/100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-2deg)} 50%{transform:translateY(-10px) rotate(2deg)}). Gate all decorative motion behind html[data-js], and add `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` + `html:not([data-js])` fallbacks that disable animation.

globals.css scroll-progress + header chrome: style #scroll-progress (fixed, height 3px, width 0%, background linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-accent-hover), oklch(0.92 0.05 305)), z-index 200). Style the header as sticky top:0 z-index:100 flex space-between padding 14px clamp(20px,4vw,48px) transparent, transition background/box-shadow/padding/backdrop-filter .3s; add a `[data-scrolled]` state selector giving background color-mix(in oklch, white 82%, transparent), box-shadow 0 8px 30px rgba(20,10,30,.08), backdrop-filter blur(14px), padding 10px clamp(20px,4vw,48px).

Nav.tsx (client): render the prototype header. Logo = next/image /demaze-logo.png height ~30px linking to /. Center nav = next/link to /projects (Projects), /services (Services), /about-us (About Us), /contact-us (Contact Us) using usePathname for active state (active = accent color + 2px accent-hover bottom border; base = ink color transparent border). Right = a 'Book a call' pill link to /contact-us (solid accent fill, #fff, 8px radius, 10px 18px, 13px weight700, with an aria-hidden arrow). Add a scroll listener (rAF-throttled, passive) that sets data-scrolled on the header element when window.scrollY>40 and removes it at top; guard for reduced-motion is not needed (it is a state toggle, not motion) but must be no-JS safe (header renders fine without the attribute). Preserve a responsive mobile menu (reuse the existing details/summary pattern or a simpler disclosure) so <=820px still navigates.

Footer.tsx (server): render the prototype's shared footer for every page. A CTA band: grid auto/1fr/auto, padding 36px clamp(24px,4vw,48px), border-radius 22px, background linear-gradient(120deg, oklch(0.94 0.052 135), oklch(0.94 0.04 220)); left an aria-hidden decorative mark (use existing /demaze-logo.png via next/image OR an inline SVG/gradient block, NOT a missing footer.png); middle eyebrow 'Have a project in mind?' + h2 'Let\'s build smarter, together.'; right a 'Start a conversation' pink pill link to /contact-us. Below it a slim <footer> with border-top 1px var(--color-line), muted 13px text: left 'DEMAze Technologies (c) 2026. All rights reserved.' (use the actual copyright symbol, avoid em dash), right 'Ahmedabad, India'. Keep footer nav links accessible.

Create src/components/SiteMotion.tsx (client) OR extend MotionControl.tsx: a single motion controller with hardcoded defaults serviceImageFit='contain', motionIntensity='subtle', autoplayHeroVideo=true (NO prop editor). Responsibilities, all rAF-throttled + passive + reduced-motion/no-JS safe: (a) scroll-progress bar width = scrollY/(scrollHeight-innerHeight); (b) header data-scrolled toggle (can live in Nav instead - pick one place, do not double-bind); (c) reveal-on-scroll for [data-reveal] (initial opacity0 translateY(subtle=14px); IntersectionObserver threshold .12 rootMargin '0px 0px -8%'; above-fold revealed synchronously; 1500ms safety timeout force-reveals all; transition opacity .7s + transform .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.25,1)); (d) metric count-up for [data-metric] with data-target/data-prefix/data-suffix (IO threshold .4; ~1100ms cubic ease-out 0->target; reduced-motion = instant final value; text = prefix+value+suffix); (e) hero frame parallax translateY(min(scrollY*0.08,60)) + scale(max(0.96,1-scrollY*0.00008)) on [data-hero-frame]; (f) services sticky-stage focus (see FEAT-002 markup contract: [data-service-row] 0..3 and [data-service-img] 0..3; lerp-smoothed rAF loop computing each row's focus by distance of its center from viewport center, subtle falloff 0.6; focused row opacity .32->1 + translate + scale; matching sticky image crossfades opacity/translate/blur so exactly one shows); (g) parallax-img top shift for [data-parallax-img]. Respect prefers-reduced-motion (everything shown, no animation, count-up instant) and require html[data-js]. Preserve the existing ambient-motion toggle + [data-animated-visual] behavior from MotionControl (do not regress it). Mount this controller from layout.tsx (replace or sit alongside MotionControl).

globals.css: add the reveal/count-up base styles ([data-reveal] initial hidden state gated by html[data-js]; revealed state) and any shared button/link primitives the redesigned pages need (pink solid pill button, pink text link with arrow, eyebrow with pulse dot). Ensure a 1500ms JS safety net is matched by CSS that shows content if JS never runs (html:not([data-js]) [data-reveal] { opacity:1; transform:none }).
acceptance_criteria: layout.tsx imports DM_Sans and Space_Grotesk from next/font/google with the stated weights and variable names, and both variable classNames are on <html>.
A #scroll-progress element exists in the DOM on every page and is styled as a fixed 3px gradient bar.

Nav renders next/link items Projects, Services, About Us, Contact Us with usePathname-driven active styling, a logo link home, and a 'Book a call' pill to /contact-us; header gains a scrolled state past 40px.

Footer renders a gradient CTA band (eyebrow 'Have a project in mind?', h2 'Let\'s build smarter, together.', 'Start a conversation' pill to /contact-us) and a slim copyright/location footer, with no src to a missing asset.

A single client motion module provides reveal, count-up, header/scroll-progress, hero parallax, services sticky-stage and img parallax, all reduced-motion and no-JS safe with hardcoded defaults contain/subtle/true, and the existing ambient-motion toggle still works.

globals.css defines the oklch token set, the three keyframes (pulse-dot, marquee-scroll, chip-drift), scroll-progress and sticky-header chrome, and [data-reveal] base styles with a no-JS visible fallback.
`unset NODE_OPTIONS && node scripts/check-copy.mjs src` passes with no findings.
verification: unset NODE_OPTIONS && node scripts/check-copy.mjs src (must print 'Copy check passed')
Read layout.tsx, Nav.tsx, Footer.tsx and the motion module; confirm imports resolve to real files/fonts and no reference to a nonexistent public/ asset.
grep for demaze-robot-studio, footer.png, tech-, project-*.webp, service-*.webp, about.webp, founder.webp in src/ and confirm none are used as an /
If npm deps ever install: unset NODE_OPTIONS && npm run build && npm run lint && npm run format:check
findings:
Implemented the redesign foundation. layout.tsx now imports DM_Sans (400;500;600;700 -> --font-dm-sans-var) and Space_Grotesk (500;600;700 -> --font-space-grotesk-var) from next/font/google; both variable classNames are on , and a `
` is the first child of . NOTE on font var naming: next/font sets the raw family under --font-dm-sans-var / --font-space-grotesk-var, and the @theme tokens --font-dm-sans / --font-space-grotesk wrap those with fallbacks. This avoids the circular self-reference you get if the @theme token and the next/font variable share the same name. Later features must use var(--font-space-grotesk) / var(--font-dm-sans) (the @theme tokens), NOT the -var names. globals.css: added the oklch token set with -oklch suffixes on ink/muted/accent/line (--color-ink-oklch, --color-muted-oklch, --color-accent-oklch, --color-accent-hover, --color-accent-light, --color-line-oklch, --color-page, and the four pastels --color-pastel-lavender/blue/mint/butter) because the legacy hex tokens (--color-ink, --color-muted, --color-accent, --color-line) are still referenced by unconverted CSS and were left intact per the plan. body/html base set to --color-page / --color-ink-oklch / var(--font-dm-sans). Added the three keyframes verbatim (pulse-dot, marquee-scroll, chip-drift), #scroll-progress styling, .site-header sticky chrome with [data-scrolled] frosted state, [data-reveal] base + no-JS/reduced-motion fallbacks, and shared primitives .pill-button / .arrow-link / .eyebrow-dot. Reworked Nav.tsx to the prototype header (.site-header, .header-brand logo -> /demaze-logo.png only, .header-nav with Projects/Services/About Us/Contact Us + usePathname active state, .pill-button 'Book a call' -> /contact-us, and a <=820px details/summary disclosure). The scroll listener that toggles [data-scrolled] lives ONLY in SiteMotion (single place, not double-bound). Reworked Footer.tsx: gradient .cta-band (eyebrow 'Have a project in mind?', h2 'Let's build smarter, together.', 'Start a conversation' pill) with an inline-SVG decorative mark (no missing asset), and a .slim-footer with copyright (uses ©, the real copyright symbol, no em dash) + 'Ahmedabad, India'. Created src/components/SiteMotion.tsx (replaces MotionControl.tsx, which was git-removed since nothing else imported it) with hardcoded defaults serviceImageFit='contain', motionIntensity='subtle', autoplayHeroVideo=true (set as html data-* attributes for later features), preserving the legacy ambient-motion toggle + [data-animated-visual] behavior, and adding rAF-throttled + passive scroll-progress, header data-scrolled, [data-reveal] IO (threshold .12, rootMargin '0px 0px -8%', above-fold sync reveal, 1500ms safety timeout), [data-metric] count-up (IO threshold .4, ~1100ms ease-out cubic, reduced-motion instant), [data-hero-frame] parallax translateY(min(scrollY*0.08,60))+scale(max(0.96,1-scrollY*0.00008)), #services-stage sticky-stage focus (lerp 0.12 smoothing, distance-to-viewport-centre falloff, opacity .32->1, exactly one [data-service-img] active via crossfade), and [data-parallax-img] top shift. All reduced-motion + no-JS safe. Verification: `unset NODE_OPTIONS && node scripts/check-copy.mjs src` prints 'Copy check passed: 32 files scanned.' No /
